admission.justification: Eleven folder tests pin the one-folder answer, stable order, parts, confinement and the removed whole-tree answer, each failing on targeted revert; the mechanism spans the serving module whose three functions the entry names.

applicability: Every notes-folder request served by the product, on any master.
conditions: The request names one folder under the notes root; the answer carries that folder's entries in the stable total order, in parts of at most 200.
Confinement holds across the request: a directory swapped for a symlink mid-request reads as gone, never as outside entries.
exclusions: No whole-tree answer exists; nothing outside the notes root is ever listed.
No state is kept between requests; a fresh request re-reads the folder.
statement: The server answers one notes folder per request in a stable total order (directories first, case-folded name, exact name breaking ties) and in parts of 200, opens folders through held descriptors without following symlinks, and the whole-tree answer stays removed with no caller.
